notes.title: Game Release Update
notes.content:
Hello, dear reader!

As you may or may not know, the game was originally planned to be released on December 25 at 00:00 CET. However, unfortunately the game is not in a state to be released yet and it will need some more time before it's ready. I still have some essential things I need to implement and there's a bit of polish required as well. The release date will be announced at a later date, once the game is ready for release. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

-Not Lolpan
